omissions.reason: Topic, explanatory, anaphoric, citation-source and quotation grammar is distributed across the two English sentences. First but and is only qualify the book statement as a whole; neither DE nor YANG alone securely owns that restriction. Bound genitives are not split, and the source LAS does not have a separate from in the English book-as-subject construction. No uncertain grammar is nulled.

The complete title is secure. RNAL BYOR separately has practitioners, but the full RNAL BYOR SPYOD PA record concerns yogic practice/Yogacara and lacks that HGM equivalent; assigning a precise practitioner subspan within this conventional title remains uncertain. Retain SA/Levels only as an independently secure member.
